entities.summary: Anthony David Benavidez is an American professional boxer who has held world championships in two weight classes. He has held the World Boxing Association (WBA) light heavyweight title since February 2025 and the World Boxing Council (WBC) light heavyweight title since April 2025. Previously, he held the WBC super middleweight title twice between 2017 and 2020.
